swh.label: Wave height
swh.description: Significant height of combined wind waves and swell (synthetic)

pp1d.label: Peak period
pp1d.description: Period of the primary wave component (synthetic)

mwd.label: Peak direction
mwd.description: Direction the primary wave component comes FROM (synthetic)

shww.label: Wind-wave height
shww.description: Significant height of the locally generated wind sea (synthetic)

mpww.label: Wind-wave period
mpww.description: Mean period of the locally generated wind sea (synthetic)

mdww.label: Wind-wave direction
mdww.description: Direction the wind sea comes FROM (synthetic)

swell1_h.label: Primary swell height
swell1_h.description: Significant height of the first swell partition (synthetic)

swell1_p.label: Primary swell period
swell1_p.description: Mean period of the first swell partition (synthetic)

swell1_d.label: Primary swell direction
swell1_d.description: Direction the first swell partition comes FROM (synthetic)

directionConvention: Wave directions are the bearing waves travel FROM, in degrees true, like the wind direction rows: 270° is a westerly swell running east.
partitionNote: swh/pp1d/mwd describe the whole spectrum; shww/mpww/mdww are the wind sea and swell1_* the first swell partition. These are sample values, not a sea state.
attribution: Synthetic sample data for tests — not a forecast
processing: Generated by scripts/sample-weather.mjs. The field is a smooth analytic function of position and lead time, not model output, and describes no real weather at any time.
